name: Shiori
message: "This place brings back complicated feelings for me... in more ways than one..."

name: Shiori
message: "Back when we first came here looking into the accident, I felt something was off."

name: Shiori
message: "For some reason, this place felt familiar, yet not quite either."

name: Shiori
message: "But I guess it was only natural. I hardly ever came to this area when I was alive."

name: Shiori
message: "My instinct was right, but I can't really say this place has absolutely nothing to do with me either."

name: Shiori
message: "To think that Gyaruko-san died here..."

name: Shiori
message: "If we hadn't looked into the incident, if we had never learned the name Aoi Lumina..."

name: Shiori
message: "...if Gyaruko-san had never regained her memories, could we still have been friends right now?"

name: Shiori
message: "But... if Gyaruko-san hadn't told us about the culprit, I would never have gotten my memories back..."

name: Shiori
message: "Ms. Librarian's... 'tie theory,' was it? Every encounter has meaning."

name: Shiori
message: "Maybe we were fated to end up like this from the moment we met..."

name: Shiori
message: "...I know I'm gazing into the distance, acting all cool and melancholic, but..."

name: Shiori
message: "As soon as the light turned green, my past screwup came rushing back and my brain just froze."

name: Shiori
message: "And that photo... it's still in the Death Diary, isn't it? I was the one who said I'd keep it as a reminder, but... I'm starting to want a retake..."

name: Shiori
message: "But it's a bit late for that now... And I'd feel kinda bad making you look at my gruesome corpse..."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, but I'm sure you wouldn't even bat an eye. Ehehe."

name: Shiori
message: "Oh right... did I ever tell you? It's about my sister again."

name: Shiori
message: "Like you, she was completely unfazed by corpses. Fictional ones, of course. She'd even get a kick out of it."

name: Shiori
message: "Whenever a corpse showed up in a horror movie, she'd just start laughing. Most kids that age wouldn't even want to look. I still wonder what she found so funny."

name: Shiori
message: "I'm pretty okay with horror myself, but my sister was on another level. Honestly, given her age, it was almost terrifying..."

name: Shiori
message: "Maybe she just liked the whole horror and occult atmosphere. Dad used to buy her picture books and encyclopedias with yokai and ghosts in them."

name: Shiori
message: "At first, I'd read them aloud, but before long she could read them on her own."

name: Shiori
message: "I think she could already handle simple kanji... I guess she was a fast learner. Dad was really happy about it. He would keep saying how smart she was."

name: Shiori
message: "But Mom... she was rather worried. Like, isn't it kinda bad if a kid laughs at horror movies instead of getting scared? Will she be okay in the future?"

name: Shiori
message: "That might be why she kept pushing her to go play outside, like she had this whole 'we have to raise her into a cheerful, outgoing kid or it'll be bad' mindset."

name: Shiori
message: "Even so, she never went as far as telling her what not to watch or what not to do, so I think she still respected my sister's independence."

name: Shiori
message: "She was like that with me too. She'd tell me what to do, but she'd never just shut things down and say no."

name: Shiori
message: "Dad, on the other hand, was the type who supported everything we did. He was always cheering us on."

name: Shiori
message: "But I never really managed to repay them..."

name: Shiori
message: "Now then, shall we move on to the next spot?"
